versionAuthority.rule: Every eventual active dependency declaration resolves from its owning catalog. Versions inside canonical-source/SOURCE.json are immutable upstream provenance only. Fail on absent entries, unavailable pinned tools, mismatched versions or prerelease tool selections; do not bootstrap ambient tools.

requiredDeterministicPipeline: Verify retained source archive and npm baseline integrity against SOURCE.json; verify source-file hashes. Extract to an explicitly bounded scratch directory in the existing primary checkout, never a new worktree. Retained upstream manifests and lockfiles remain provenance and are not active workspaces or install inputs.

Apply only the reviewed canonical-source correction inputs and exact versioned protocol/spec source additions. Recreate protocol types and validation schemas with the reviewed pinned generator. Fail when canonical inputs or owning catalog selections are missing; do not patch generated TypeScript, JS, declarations, source maps or IIFEs by hand.

Use the selected Puck Node and catalog TypeScript 7 CLI to typecheck and emit provider modules and declarations. Preserve upstream ES2023 target and both browser/Node checks. Handle the retained .ts import specifier through reviewed compiler configuration, not string rewriting of emitted JS.

Bundle the mapperTab from rebuilt bidiTab source with a reviewed catalog-pinned bundler configuration. Preserve third-party license comments and reproduce a deterministic, dependency-identified THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES; fail unlicensed dependencies as upstream does. An esbuild substitution for upstream Rollup needs explicit output/export/license parity evidence.

Materialize the exact original stable package layout including its main/type metadata and all published module/declaration/type paths. CJS compatibility on selected Node means real require(packageRoot), ESM means real import through the package entrypoint, and mapperTab means the rebuilt browser bundle. Do not invent lib/cjs or lib/esm trees absent from the upstream package.

Diff the rebuilt candidate against the integrity-verified stable npm baseline with canonical ordering, LF patch lines, fixed source-map roots, no absolute local paths, timestamps or nondeterministic banners. No dependency or browser revision metadata change may be hidden in the patch.

Independently rebuild twice from clean bounded scratch inputs and compare complete output inventories and patch SHA256. Retain tool/catalog/source/license/input hashes and output hashes. No reproducibility claim precedes matching outputs.

Parent reviews generated patch and passes acceptance-plan.json before adding exact Puppeteer parent selectors, catalog entries, patch registration or lock changes. No current production wiring is provided by this design.

preservedBrowserSource.rule: These are preserved observed native revisions, not active dependency declarations or new version authority. No downgrade or capability removal is permitted.
